SDLC Model

Agile Methodology

🗂️
Phase 1

Planning

Define project scope, identify stakeholders, set sprint goals and allocate resources.

🎨
Phase 2

Design

Architecture design, UI/UX wireframes, database schema and API contracts.

💻
Phase 3

Development

Sprint-based iterative coding with daily standups and continuous integration.

🧪
Phase 4

Testing

Unit, integration, UAT and performance testing across all modules.

🚀
Phase 5

Deployment

CI/CD pipeline, App Store and Play Store releases with phased rollout.

🔄
Phase 6

Maintenance

Bug fixes, feature updates, scaling, security patches and user feedback loops.

Analysis

Requirement Analysis

✅

Functional Requirements

  • User Registration & Login (OTP / OAuth)
  • Send and receive disappearing Snaps
  • Stories — 24-hour posts
  • Real-time Chat with media sharing
  • Snap Map — live location sharing
  • AR Filters, Lenses and Effects
  • Discover — curated content feed
  • Group Snaps and Group Chats
  • Push and in-app Notifications
⚡

Non-Functional Requirements

  • Performance — snap delivery under 2 seconds
  • Scalability — 300M+ daily active users
  • Security — end-to-end encryption
  • Availability — 99.99% uptime SLA
  • Usability — camera-first intuitive UI
  • Compatibility — iOS 13+ / Android 8+
  • Privacy — GDPR and CCPA compliant
  • Storage — auto-delete after view

Quality Assurance

Testing & QA

🧪

Types of Testing

  • Unit Testing — individual module validation
  • Integration Testing — module interaction checks
  • System Testing — end-to-end flow validation
  • UAT — user acceptance testing
  • Performance Testing — load and stress tests
  • Security Testing — penetration and encryption tests
🛠️

Tools Used

  • JUnit — unit testing framework
  • Selenium — UI automation testing
  • Postman — API testing
  • JMeter — performance and load testing
  • Firebase Test Lab — mobile device testing
  • SonarQube — code quality analysis
